race.comment: AWESOME BANDIT (1) scored well last start as odds-on favourite by 4 lengths at Ballarat in a handy 24.83 beating Aussie Moss. Well suited by the inside box and likes the trip. Winner at his latest appearance in the quickest time on the card. Makes plenty of appeal on the back of that last-start win. LADY RAPID (2) is better than last start when fifth (30.35) from Box 1 at Sandown over 515m. Has ability and can measure up. SOFT BEAUTY (3) finished in the minors last time but the start prior broke the clock when winning over 450m at this track, taking a Grade 5 in a strong 25.38. Has the ability and looks a key chance. GERALDTON CREW (7) is last start winner who looks one of the chances.
